environment.authority: source-bound compiler and scene contract tests first; governed ORM and acceptance follow

validation_results.notes: Designed scene preservation, ordinary action delegation, directory pruning, deterministic identity and scene-ready shell merge all passed.
The target also passed its nested navigation compiler, runtime capability catalog, scene shell and menu authorization suites.
The frontend scene registry consumes a generated native-delegate row and resolves its native action target.
Real system.init output contains only /s routes for executable leaves and explicit designed_scene/native_delegate content kinds.
All affected targets exited zero after correcting frontend target path selection and routing the list-surface probe change to its existing contract lock.

validation_results.reason: The released list-surface browser probe required the exact native /a route and could not locate the same entry after navigation was scenarioized to /s.
validation_results.recovery: The probe now retains the native action route as a matching identity while navigating through the delivered scene route.
validation_results.recovery_check: 23 tests passed; the probe change is routed to its existing contract lock.

validation_results.reason: The native-delegate scene-ready target incorrectly declared entry_intent=ui.contract. SceneView therefore selected the scene-block contract path instead of embedding the native action, producing a 400 ui.contract request without action identity.
validation_results.recovery: Native-delegate shell targets now expose only route/action/menu/model/view_mode and no scene entry intent; action identity drives native ActionView embedding.

validation_results.reason: The scenarioized list page rendered and completed its 18-state structure matrix, but the record walk still parsed the action id from the /s scene path instead of the navigation node's retained native action identity.
validation_results.recovery: Both form-profile and record walk paths now resolve action/menu identity through one helper backed by the declared nativeRoute; a scene route without native identity fails explicitly.
validation_results.recovery_check: node --check PASS; 24 list-surface contract tests PASS.

validation_results.reason: The record contract, approved binding and renderer passed at 1440 and the screenshot showed the source list restored, but the return assertion required byte-identical query text. The frontend canonically adds scene identity to the scene route.
validation_results.recovery: Return checks now require the same scene path plus source menu identity, and require action identity when present; canonical scene/action query additions are accepted while missing or mismatched source identity fails.
validation_results.recovery_check: 24 list-surface contract tests PASS, including positive canonical-route and negative missing/mismatched-route cases.

validation_results.reason: After the assertion failure the browser probe remained in teardown for about 18 minutes instead of failing promptly.
validation_results.recovery: Context close, browser close and lease release now each have a bounded 10-second wait; a timed-out cleanup is reported and exits after evidence is written.
validation_results.recovery_check: The cleanup contract is locked by verify.frontend.list_surface_search_contract.unit.

validation_results.notes: Protected squash merge completed; main tree matches the candidate tree. All four required gates and backend/ORM checks passed on the exact source SHA.
The probe consumes the released My Work menu identity, requires designed_scene and /s/my_work.workspace, and rejects ActionView or /my-work entry.
The formerly dead My Work guard target is now wired through ci.local.iteration; its stale dead-surface disposition was removed with an audit reason.
All required P4 targets for the probe, guard, mapping, standard preview and lane coverage passed.

blockers: The designed_scene behavior acceptance for my_work.workspace has not yet been executed through the final scene route.
next_exact_step: Adapt the existing My Work acceptance probe to resolve my_work.workspace from final system.init, assert designed_scene, and verify the rendered MyWorkView without ActionView.

layer.why_here: The final route and client contract are platform compilation responsibilities.
layer.why_not_elsewhere: Native facts cannot own product paths, scene composition cannot create native facts, and frontend cannot synthesize scene routes.
layer.blast_radius: final navigation routes, generated scene-ready shells, and generic native action embedding.
